memoryRule: a situated gaze makes the nearest aperture agent refuse, changes the depth order, redirects the shared opening to a distant agent, and increases refusal debt
interactionRule: pointer proximity arms only; tap, hold, Enter, and Space commit one bounded aperture refusal; Delete lifts the latest refusal; release clears the gaze history
representationRupture: raster population, continuous membrane, and reciprocal plates -> an ordered aperture of hinged agents whose visibility is defined by depth and occlusion
encounterRupture: sustained attention or pressure -> proximity selects a situated blade, then a discrete commitment changes the shared viewing order
temporalRupture: density transfer and material resistance -> bounded refusal debt that redirects later attention to another agent
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision verification
